title: Enjoyable
subtitle: 「令人愉快的／好玩的／令人滿足的」，要先分清愉快來自舒適、娛樂、成就感、投入感、放鬆，還是更深層的意義。
description: 「令人愉快的／好玩的／令人滿足的」，要先分清愉快來自舒適、娛樂、成就感、投入感、放鬆，還是更深層的意義。

words.example: We had a pleasant afternoon by the harbour.
words.exampleZh: 我們在海港邊度過了一個愉快的下午。

exercises.original: We had an enjoyable afternoon by the harbour.
exercises.zh: 我們在海港邊度過了一個愉快的下午。
exercises.upgrade: We had a pleasant afternoon by the harbour.

options.explanation: afternoon + harbour suggests mild, comfortable enjoyment，pleasant 最自然。
interesting 只表示能吸引注意，不保證令人愉快。
exciting 會加入高刺激感，原句沒有。
comfortable 偏身體／環境舒適，不完整表達整個下午的愉快。
successful 不適合描述休閒下午的感受。
popular 描述很多人喜歡，不是當事人的體驗。

exercises.original: The journey was enjoyable and the weather was mild.
exercises.zh: 旅程愉快，而且天氣溫和。
exercises.upgrade: The journey was pleasant and the weather was mild.

options.explanation: mild weather + journey 指舒服愉快的體驗。
exciting 會把旅程描述成刺激冒險，語氣不符。
funny 表示好笑，和旅程舒適感不同。

exercises.original: We had an enjoyable conversation over lunch.
exercises.zh: 我們午餐時有一段愉快的談話。
exercises.upgrade: We had a pleasant conversation over lunch.

options.explanation: conversation was agreeable and enjoyable，pleasant 是常見搭配。
funny necessarily 會假定談話以笑話為主。
comfortable 可形容氣氛，但較少直接概括談話內容。
successful 不自然形容一般談話。

words.example: The museum has several fun activities for children.
words.exampleZh: 博物館有多項適合兒童的有趣活動。

exercises.original: The museum has several enjoyable activities for children.
exercises.zh: 博物館有多項適合兒童的有趣活動。
exercises.upgrade: The museum has several fun activities for children.

options.explanation: children + activities strongly supports lively enjoyment，fun 最自然。
pleasant only 太溫和，未突出活動好玩。
comfortable 不適合活動娛樂性。

exercises.original: The game was enjoyable even though we lost.
exercises.zh: 雖然我們輸了，但遊戲很好玩。
exercises.upgrade: The game was fun even though we lost.

options.explanation: game + despite losing means enjoyment comes from play itself。
successful 與 losing 甚至可能衝突，而且不是體驗感。
popular 不表示我們個人享受。
comfortable 不適合遊戲的娛樂性。
interesting only 可能吸引注意，但 fun 更直接。

exercises.original: The class activity was enjoyable and everyone joined in.
exercises.zh: 課堂活動很好玩，所有人都有參與。
exercises.upgrade: The class activity was fun and everyone joined in.

options.explanation: everyone joined in suggests lively participation and enjoyment。
successful 可形容教學成果，但不直接表示活動好玩。
popular 是群體偏好，不等於活動本身的體驗。
exciting necessarily 太強，不一定刺激。

words.meaning: 令人滿足的；有成就感的
words.example: Finishing the project after months of work was extremely satisfying.
words.exampleZh: 經過數月工作後完成項目，令人非常有滿足感。

exercises.original: Finishing the project after months of work was very enjoyable.
exercises.zh: 經過數月工作後完成項目，令人非常有滿足感。
exercises.upgrade: Finishing the project after months of work was very satisfying.

options.explanation: months of work + completion points to achievement and fulfilment。
fun 偏娛樂，不適合長期項目完成後的成就感。
comfortable 不是完成工作的心理滿足。

exercises.original: Solving the final problem was especially enjoyable.
exercises.zh: 解決最後一道問題尤其令人滿足。
exercises.upgrade: Solving the final problem was especially satisfying.

options.explanation: solving a difficult problem produces a sense of completion。
exciting only 可能有興奮感，但不如 satisfying 表達成就。

exercises.original: It was enjoyable to see the garden finally take shape.
exercises.zh: 看到花園終於成形，令人很有滿足感。
exercises.upgrade: It was satisfying to see the garden finally take shape.

options.explanation: finally take shape implies satisfaction from seeing results。
easy 不表示成果帶來滿足。

words.example: The documentary was informative and entertaining.
words.exampleZh: 這套紀錄片既有資訊性又富娛樂性。

exercises.original: The documentary was informative and enjoyable.
exercises.zh: 紀錄片既有資訊性又富娛樂性。
exercises.upgrade: The documentary was informative and entertaining.

options.explanation: documentary + informative pairs naturally with entertaining。
comfortable 不描述媒體娛樂性。
successful 是作品成果，不是觀看感受。
pleasant only 太溫和，沒有娛樂內容意味。

exercises.original: The speaker was enjoyable and kept the audience laughing.
exercises.zh: 講者很有娛樂性，令觀眾一直發笑。
exercises.upgrade: The speaker was entertaining and kept the audience laughing.

options.explanation: kept audience laughing directly supports entertaining。
popular only 不表示現場表現有趣。
successful 可指演講成功，但不表示娛樂性。
relaxing 和一直發笑不完全相同。

exercises.original: The show was enjoyable from beginning to end.
exercises.zh: 節目由頭到尾都很有娛樂性。
exercises.upgrade: The show was entertaining from beginning to end.

options.explanation: show + sustained enjoyment is classic entertaining。
successful 可能是票房或製作成功。
interesting only 未必帶娛樂性。

words.meaning: 令人欣喜的；十分愉快的
words.example: We spent a delightful evening at the small restaurant.
words.exampleZh: 我們在那間小餐廳度過了一個十分愉快的晚上。

exercises.original: We spent an enjoyable evening at the small restaurant.
exercises.zh: 我們在小餐廳度過了一個十分愉快的晚上。
exercises.upgrade: We spent a delightful evening at the small restaurant.

options.explanation: pleasant charming evening supports stronger delightful。
comfortable only 太偏舒適，缺少欣喜感。

exercises.original: The little village was an enjoyable place to stay.
exercises.zh: 那個小村落是一個令人欣喜的住宿地方。
exercises.upgrade: The little village was a delightful place to stay.

options.explanation: little village + pleasant stay gives charm/pleasure nuance。
interesting 可以形容地方，但未必令人愉悅。

exercises.original: The unexpected gift made the evening especially enjoyable.
exercises.zh: 意外的禮物令晚上格外令人欣喜。
exercises.upgrade: The unexpected gift made the evening especially delightful.

options.explanation: unexpected gift adds joy and charm，delightful 最貼切。
popular 不描述當事人感受。

words.meaning: 有收穫的；令人有成就感的
words.example: Volunteering at the centre was a rewarding experience.
words.exampleZh: 在中心做義工是一段很有收穫的經歷。

exercises.original: Volunteering at the centre was an enjoyable experience.
exercises.zh: 在中心做義工是一段很有收穫的經歷。
exercises.upgrade: Volunteering at the centre was a rewarding experience.

options.explanation: volunteering often gives meaning and personal value，rewarding 最自然。
fun only 會把重點縮成娛樂。
exciting 不是義工體驗的核心。

exercises.original: Teaching beginners can be very enjoyable.
exercises.zh: 教授初學者可以很有收穫。
exercises.upgrade: Teaching beginners can be very rewarding.

options.explanation: teaching gives satisfaction from helping others and seeing progress。
easy 未必，教初學者可能很難。
pleasant only 太淺，未表達收穫感。

exercises.original: The research project was difficult but enjoyable.
exercises.zh: 研究項目雖困難，卻很有收穫。
exercises.upgrade: The research project was difficult but rewarding.

options.explanation: difficult but positive suggests value and fulfilment rather than simple pleasure。
popular 不涉及研究者感受。

words.example: The teacher used an engaging activity to introduce the topic.
words.exampleZh: 老師用一項很吸引人的活動介紹課題。

exercises.original: The teacher used an enjoyable activity to introduce the topic.
exercises.zh: 老師用一項很吸引人的活動介紹課題。
exercises.upgrade: The teacher used an engaging activity to introduce the topic.

options.explanation: activity is designed to hold attention and involvement。
successful 可以是教學成果，但不表示吸引力。

exercises.original: The speaker made a difficult topic enjoyable for the audience.
exercises.zh: 講者令艱深課題變得吸引人。
exercises.upgrade: The speaker made a difficult topic engaging for the audience.

options.explanation: difficult topic becomes interesting enough to hold attention，engaging 精準。
easy 會錯說主題本身變簡單。
popular 不表示當場吸引力。

exercises.original: The article is enjoyable because it keeps the reader's attention.
exercises.zh: 文章很吸引，能一直抓住讀者注意力。
exercises.upgrade: The article is engaging because it keeps the reader's attention.

options.explanation: keeps attention is the direct diagnostic clue for engaging。
popular 不等於個別讀者投入。
pleasant only 未突出注意力。

words.meaning: 好笑的；有趣的；逗人發笑的
words.example: He told an amusing story about his first day at work.
words.exampleZh: 他講了一個關於第一天上班的有趣故事。

exercises.original: He told an enjoyable story that made everyone laugh.
exercises.zh: 他講了一個有趣的故事，令大家發笑。
exercises.upgrade: He told an amusing story that made everyone laugh.

options.explanation: made everyone laugh directly signals amusing。
successful 可說故事講得成功，但沒有笑的語義。
relaxing 和發笑不是同一核心。

exercises.original: The comment was enjoyable because of its dry humour.
exercises.zh: 那句評論因冷面幽默而很有趣。
exercises.upgrade: The comment was amusing because of its dry humour.

options.explanation: dry humour is a direct clue for amusement。

exercises.original: We found the misunderstanding enjoyable rather than annoying.
exercises.zh: 我們覺得那場誤會頗有趣，而不是令人煩惱。
exercises.upgrade: We found the misunderstanding amusing rather than annoying.

options.explanation: rather than annoying + misunderstanding suggests mild humour。

words.meaning: 令人放鬆的；輕鬆愉快的
words.example: We had a relaxing weekend in the countryside.
words.exampleZh: 我們在鄉郊度過了一個輕鬆的週末。

exercises.original: We had an enjoyable weekend in the countryside.
exercises.zh: 我們在鄉郊度過了一個輕鬆的週末。
exercises.upgrade: We had a relaxing weekend in the countryside.

options.explanation: countryside weekend naturally suggests rest and low stress。

exercises.original: The music made the evening more enjoyable and calm.
exercises.zh: 音樂令晚上更輕鬆愉快。
exercises.upgrade: The music made the evening more relaxing and calm.

options.explanation: calm is a direct clue for relaxing。
engaging only 強調注意力，未必令人放鬆。

exercises.original: A quiet walk after work can be very enjoyable.
exercises.zh: 下班後安靜散步可以很令人放鬆。
exercises.upgrade: A quiet walk after work can be very relaxing.

options.explanation: quiet walk after work suggests stress reduction。
exciting 與 quiet relaxation 相反。

words.meaning: 令人愉悅的；帶來快感的
words.example: Reading for pleasure can be a deeply pleasurable activity.
words.exampleZh: 為興趣而閱讀可以是一項非常愉悅的活動。

exercises.original: Reading for pleasure can be an enjoyable activity.
exercises.zh: 為興趣而閱讀可以是一項很愉悅的活動。
exercises.upgrade: Reading for pleasure can be a pleasurable activity.

exercises.original: The experience was enjoyable without being exciting.
exercises.zh: 這段經歷令人愉悅，但並不刺激。
exercises.upgrade: The experience was pleasurable without being exciting.

options.explanation: explicit contrast with exciting shows calm pleasure rather than excitement。
engaging 強調注意力，未必 pleasure。

exercises.original: Many people find gardening enjoyable in itself.
exercises.zh: 很多人覺得園藝本身就令人愉悅。
exercises.upgrade: Many people find gardening pleasurable in itself.

options.explanation: find ... in itself enjoyable is direct pleasure language。
popular 是群體層面受歡迎。
comfortable 可描述身體感受但不是整體樂趣。

words.meaning: 令人充實的；令人滿足的
words.example: She found teaching both challenging and fulfilling.
words.exampleZh: 她覺得教學既有挑戰性又令人充實。

exercises.original: She found teaching both challenging and enjoyable.
exercises.zh: 她覺得教學既有挑戰性又令人充實。
exercises.upgrade: She found teaching both challenging and fulfilling.

options.explanation: challenging but positive points to deep meaning and purpose。

exercises.original: The role is demanding but highly enjoyable because it feels meaningful.
exercises.zh: 這個角色要求很高，但因為有意義而令人充實。
exercises.upgrade: The role is demanding but highly fulfilling because it feels meaningful.

options.explanation: meaningful is the direct clue for fulfilling。
exciting only 不能表達 purpose。

exercises.original: Caring for others can be difficult but enjoyable in a deeper sense.
exercises.zh: 照顧他人雖然困難，但在更深層意義上令人充實。
exercises.upgrade: Caring for others can be difficult but deeply fulfilling.

options.explanation: deeper sense + caring implies purpose and personal fulfilment。
entertaining 完全不合嚴肅照護。

words.meaning: 令人愉快的；舒適宜人的
words.example: The mild weather made the walk especially agreeable.
words.exampleZh: 溫和的天氣令散步格外愉快。

exercises.original: The mild weather made the walk especially enjoyable.
exercises.zh: 溫和天氣令散步格外愉快。
exercises.upgrade: The mild weather made the walk especially agreeable.

options.explanation: mild weather + walk suits formal pleasantness sense of agreeable。

exercises.original: He was enjoyable company during the long journey.
exercises.zh: 長途旅程中，他是一位令人愉快的同行者。
exercises.upgrade: He was agreeable company during the long journey.

options.explanation: company is a classic formal collocation with agreeable。
easy 不適合人作伴的品質。

exercises.original: The room had an enjoyable, calm atmosphere.
exercises.zh: 房間有一種愉快而平靜的氣氛。
exercises.upgrade: The room had an agreeable, calm atmosphere.

options.explanation: calm atmosphere fits formal mild pleasantness。

words.example: The quiz was good fun even though our team lost.
words.exampleZh: 雖然我們那隊輸了，但問答遊戲很好玩。

exercises.original: The quiz was enjoyable even though our team lost.
exercises.zh: 雖然我們那隊輸了，但問答遊戲很好玩。
exercises.upgrade: The quiz was good fun even though our team lost.

options.explanation: British informal context + quiz supports good fun。
successful 和 lost 不合，而且不描述樂趣。
popular 不是我們的個人感受。
interesting only 未必有玩樂感。

exercises.original: The trip was enjoyable and everyone laughed a lot.
exercises.zh: 旅程很好玩，大家都笑得很多。
exercises.upgrade: The trip was good fun and everyone laughed a lot.

options.explanation: laughter + group trip supports lively British informal enjoyment。
popular 不是當事人的樂趣。
relaxing only 未必有大量笑聲和活力。

exercises.original: The activity was enjoyable for both adults and children.
exercises.zh: 活動對成人和兒童來說都很好玩。
exercises.upgrade: The activity was good fun for both adults and children.

options.explanation: activity for mixed ages + informal evaluation suits good fun。
successful 不表達參加者感受。
comfortable 不適合活動娛樂性。

falseSynonyms.zh: 有趣不等於 enjoyable interesting 表示能引起注意或思考；有些有趣內容可以令人不安，未必令人享受。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Interesting holds attention; enjoyable gives pleasure.

falseSynonyms.zh: 刺激不等於 enjoyable exciting 強調興奮和刺激；愉快的體驗不一定令人興奮。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Exciting is high-energy; enjoyable can be calm.

falseSynonyms.zh: 舒適不等於 enjoyable comfortable 表示身體或心理舒適；舒服的椅子不是『令人享受的活動』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Comfort is one possible source of enjoyment, not the same concept.

falseSynonyms.zh: 好笑不等於 enjoyable funny 強調幽默／令人發笑；enjoyable 可以完全不涉及笑。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Funny is about humour; enjoyable is broader.

falseSynonyms.zh: 容易不等於 enjoyable easy 描述難度低；一件容易的工作仍可能非常沉悶。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Ease and enjoyment are different.

falseSynonyms.zh: 受歡迎不等於 enjoyable popular 表示很多人喜歡；不能單靠受歡迎程度證明某個人覺得享受。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Popularity is social approval, not personal enjoyment.

falseSynonyms.zh: 成功不等於 enjoyable successful 表示達成目標；成功的活動過程仍可能壓力很大。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Success concerns outcomes; enjoyment concerns experience.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 enjoy 是動詞；enjoyable 是形容詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Enjoy is a verb; enjoyable is an adjective.
